assessment_scope: Bounded Design/consumer boundary inspection of Records RF-SR-02 and Subject versus EntryRef separation, Validation selection responsibilities, actual current-record selection branch and unknown-path regression. This records the supported correction before changes; final accumulated Design and Code Review remain separate.

findings.evidence: Severity high; cross-artifact; affected owners Validation and Records/CLI boundary plus validation selector consumer. scripts/validation_selection.py _apply_path_selection around 1213-1242 emits unregistered-recording-path for every non-record-kind path in a current root, including source-disposition.md and evidence/* explicitly named as Subject in registered evidence.json. Records RF-SR-02 and Explicit record schema distinguish Subject from authoritative EntryRef; extra files do not become records by discovery. Existing scripts/test-select-validation.py unknown_value.md regression must remain.
findings.required_outcome: Clarify the narrow Validation selection application and reconcile its implementation: admit only exact contained non-reserved engineering Subject paths named through validated current manifest/registered records; select full store validation and relevant changed-subject checks without authority promotion. Keep unknown/unreferenced support paths, malformed/mixed records, unsafe/symlink paths and unregistered reserved record files blocking. Preserve schema/EntryRef/record membership, historical subjects and current drift observations. Safe path: Design owner clarifies this consumer rule and acceptance cases; Delivery allocates focused positive and negative selector protection before implementation and independent review.

resolution.rationale: Withdraw duplicate report only: independently recorded code-review-cleanup-consolidation-first / cleanup-supporting-evidence-selection is the canonical open correction covering this same selector defect. Saves crossed during parallel reviews. This disposition does not establish a fix, implementation correctness or package approval; Design must still assess the bounded Validation clarification and the code reviewer owns correction acceptance.

independence_basis: Independent delegated reviewer /root/design_refinement_review authored no reviewed models, selector implementation or tests.
limitations: This is not approval of a generic support-folder exemption, permissive recursive path search, record-schema change or relocation of evidence.
No implementation, tests or final readiness assessment was performed. Existing subject drift remains observable and cannot establish current evidence applicability.
rationale: RF-SR-02 requires registry membership for authoritative records, not every file physically under a change root. Records explicitly keeps engineering subjects in place and says extra files must not become authority through discovery.

The current selector derives a record kind solely from path; any non-reserved file under a v3 root receives unregistered-recording-path even when a valid registered evidence check names it as a Subject. Current cleanup uses such files for source dispositions and provenance, so whole selection cannot validate the otherwise structurally valid supporting evidence.

A bounded current selection rule can distinguish exact named engineering Subjects from reserved record paths without adding a stored kind, altering historical identities or promoting extra files to records. Unknown files and malformed or unsafe authority must still reject.
summary: Validation selection confuses referenced engineering support subjects with authoritative record files.
